findings.text: follow-on: the run stores its after_suite at ba4ca787d, so the head gate log does not name the reviewed head 2b1f5388b; the delta is a trailing newline only, but a reader comparing head_log_revision to reviewed_head_sha sees a mismatch. Re-run the full gate at the final head when a head commit is a style-only follow-up.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base; ba4ca787d splits _docs_scan_directories into _docs_scan_inputs (returning both listings) and a one-line _docs_scan_directories delegate that returns the directory list, retargets _estimated_hours to _docs_scan_inputs, adds tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py (a shape test and a warm-resolve test) and an empty evidence-fragment anchor; 2b1f5388b adds the trailing newline the prior review's fit finding named and nothing else.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node had no reproduction obligation of its own, and I reproduced the reviewed defect independently: at base 223187b5c tests/test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py::test_the_cut_stops_the_repeated_docs_scan fails (assert 2 == 0, 1 failed EXIT=1), the new tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py pass at head 2b1f5388b (2 passed EXIT=0), and reverting _docs_scan_directories to return the tuple reddens all three (3 failed EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a warm pick that resolves the plan path without re-walking the docs tree while the estimate stage keeps its sibling-file stamp; reckon/crew/routing.py:3684 _docs_scan_inputs returns both listings from the one walk and routing.py:3681 _docs_scan_directories returns the directory list the pick's stamp at reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:111 iterates, while _estimated_hours at routing.py:3732 reads the pair, so a warm pick resolves 0 plans through a scan where it resolved 2.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names the cause (commit ab5883931 changed routing._docs_scan_directories to return a (directories, files) tuple) with the call path pick()->_declared_difficulty()->picker._resolved_plan_path()->build()/stamp_of, carries baseline_suite (223187b5c, exit 0, completed true) and after_suite (ba4ca787d, exit 0, completed true) with literal commands, and a negative_control_log naming the mutation; the after_suite revision is ba4ca787d rather than the final head 2b1f5388b, so the format-only head commit is covered by a subset re-run (6 passed), not a full gate log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff 223187b5c..2b1f5388b touches exactly reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/pick-cache-survives-the-sibling-stamp.html, the node's declared write paths, and nothing else; write_paths in the reviewed manifest do not list the docs/evidence fragment that _context_refusal_detail was not involved with and that the diff adds, a bookkeeping gap only.

justifications.durability: reverting _docs_scan_directories to return the (directories, files) tuple in a scratch copy reddens tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py (both tests) and test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py::test_the_cut_stops_the_repeated_docs_scan (3 failed EXIT=1), so the added assertions genuinely fire on the regression.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log line 1 names ba4ca787d and ends 207 passed EXIT=0 while gate-base.log names 223187b5c and ends 205 passed EXIT=0, a 0-added delta, and my independent head gate at 2b1f5388b reproduced 206 passed / 1 load-dependent flake in an untouched file; the after_suite revision does not name the final head, so the format-only commit has no full gate log.
justifications.fit: tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py is ruff-format clean and adds no ruff findings, routing.py carries 11 findings at both base and head (delta 0), and the blank line after the multi-line docstring matches the file's own convention (90 occurrences).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:111 stores _docs_scan_directories(docs) as "directories" and the stamp joins each entry onto the docs root, so the fix restores the list[str] shape the stamp consumes and the fallback rescan is not taken; reproduced 2 warm-pick rescans at base and 0 at head.
justifications.reuse: _docs_scan_directories is a one-line delegate over the single walk in _docs_scan_inputs rather than a second scan, and a grep finds only the picker stamp and _estimated_hours as consumers.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 223187b5c..2b1f5388b lists exactly reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the node's declared write paths; no other path changed.
